title: Leadership & Management
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Un buen líder no solo da órdenes, sino que inspira y empodera a su equipo. Ahora tienes el vocabulario para liderar en inglés.

parts.visual:
Delegar y Empoderar: 
- Delegate tasks (Delegar tareas - dar responsabilidad a otros). 
- Empower (Empoderar - dar autonomía y confianza al equipo). 
- Micromanage (Microgestionar - controlar cada pequeño detalle, algo negativo). 
Ej: A good leader delegates tasks and empowers the team. They don't micromanage.
parts.audio: Delegating and Empowering. Delegate tasks means to give responsibility to others. Empower means to give autonomy and confidence to the team. Micromanage means to control every small detail, which is usually negative. For example: A good leader delegates tasks and empowers the team. They don't micromanage.

parts.visual:
Inspirar y Liderar: 
- Lead by example (Predicar con el ejemplo). 
- Visionary (Visionario - con visión de futuro). 
- Accountability (Rendición de cuentas / Responsabilidad). 
Ej: To build accountability, a visionary leader must lead by example.
parts.audio: Inspiring and Leading. Lead by example means to act in a way that shows others how they should act. Visionary means having a clear vision of the future. Accountability means taking responsibility for your actions and results. For example: To build accountability, a visionary leader must lead by example.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra de liderazgo correcta.

questions.question: As a manager, you can't do everything yourself. You need to ____ tasks to your team. (Delegar).
questions.explanation: Delegate = delegar (asignar tareas y responsabilidades a otros).

questions.question: I hate it when my boss checks every single email I send. I don't like to be ____. (Microgestionado / Controlado en exceso).
questions.explanation: Micromanage = controlar cada pequeño detalle del trabajo de alguien.

questions.question: We want to ____ our employees to make their own decisions. (Empoderar).
questions.explanation: Empower = empoderar (dar poder, autonomía y confianza).

questions.question: A great leader doesn't just give orders; they lead by ____. (Con el ejemplo).
questions.explanation: Lead by example = predicar/liderar con el ejemplo.

questions.question: There needs to be more ____ in this company. If someone makes a mistake, they must accept it. (Rendición de cuentas / Responsabilidad).
questions.explanation: Accountability = la obligación de rendir cuentas o asumir la responsabilidad de las acciones.

questions.question: Steve Jobs was considered a ____ because he saw the future of technology. (Visionario).
questions.explanation: Visionary = visionario (persona con visión a futuro).

questions.question: The manager acts as a ____, helping employees develop their skills and careers. (Mentor / Guía).
We need to ____ a culture of innovation and creativity. (Fomentar / Promover).
questions.explanation: Foster (o promote) = fomentar, cultivar o promover algo positivo.

questions.question: A good leader gives constructive ____ to help the team improve. (Retroalimentación / Comentarios).
questions.explanation: Constructive feedback = retroalimentación o crítica constructiva.

questions.question: To solve this conflict, we need some conflict ____ skills. (Resolución).
It's important to build team ____ so everyone feels connected and motivated. (Moral / Ánimo).
questions.explanation: Team morale = la moral, el estado de ánimo y la confianza del equipo.

questions.question: The CEO has an open-____ policy. Anyone can walk into her office and talk to her. (Política de puertas abiertas).
questions.explanation: Open-door policy = política de puertas abiertas (accesibilidad total).

questions.question: We need a leader who can ____ the team through this difficult transition. (Guiar / Conducir).
questions.explanation: Steer = guiar, dirigir o conducir (como el timón de un barco).

questions.question: She has great ____ intelligence, which helps her understand her team's feelings. (Inteligencia emocional).
Sometimes you have to make ____ decisions that people won't like. (Difíciles/Duras).
We must ____ our goals with the company's overall strategy. (Alinear).
questions.explanation: Align = alinear (asegurarse de que todos vayan en la misma dirección).

questions.question: He has a very ____-off management style. He lets us do our own thing. (Dejar hacer / Poca intervención).
questions.explanation: Hands-off = estilo de gestión donde el jefe interviene poco (lo opuesto a micromanage).

questions.question: Conversely, a ____-on manager is very involved in the daily work. (Con mucha intervención / Práctico).
questions.explanation: Hands-on = involucrado directamente, que pone 'las manos en la masa'.

questions.question: To succeed, we need clear and transparent ____. (Comunicación).
The manager ____ the team for their hard work on the project. (Elogió / Felicitó).
questions.explanation: Praise = elogiar, felicitar o reconocer el buen trabajo.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra correcta sobre liderazgo.

questions.question: To ____ tasks. (Delegar con D)
To ____ the team. (Empoderar con E)
Don't ____. (Microgestionar con M)
Lead by ____. (Ejemplo con E)
Build ____. (Rendición de cuentas con A)
A ____ leader. (Visionario con V)
Constructive ____. (Retroalimentación con F)
To ____ a culture. (Fomentar con F)
Team ____. (La moral/ánimo con M termina en e)
A hands-____ manager. (Poca intervención/Que deja hacer)
